subject: Re: Follow-up: Security & Private Deployment options (SOC 2, VPC, on-prem)

Subject: Follow-up: Security & Private Deployment options (SOC 2, VPC, on-prem)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and next steps on the security/deployment topics we covered: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II compliant; I attached our security brief and a link to the SOC 2 summary for the audit period (see attachment + link).
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support region-specific data residency and offer contractual addenda (DPA / BAA) for regulated workloads.
- Private/VPC/on-prem: We discussed three options: Hosted with customer-dedicated VPC peering, Dedicated (reserved GPU pools in customer VPC), and an on-prem/air-gapped package. Monica will follow up with a short deployment diagram and the differences in network isolation.

Action items I have from today:
1) Monica to share deployment diagram and network isolation summary (by EOD tomorrow).
2) Sarah to share ACME's vendor security questionnaire or let us know if you want us to start one on our side.
3) Rachel to kick off procurement/contract questions once security is aligned.

I've attached a short security brief that includes our SOC 2 summary and a sample network diagram. If you want, we can also run the completed questionnaire through our security team and return answers within 3 business days.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-security-brief.pdf

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security & Private Deployment options (SOC 2, VPC, on-prem)

Hi Sarah —

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround. Short answers up front: 
- Dedicated supports customer-managed VPC peering with strict subnet isolation (no shared subnets). We can provide an example VPC peering configuration and routing guide.
- On-prem / air-gapped: we support an offline install bundle for air-gapped environments; it’s a signed package and requires coordination with our deployment team. For highly regulated environments we typically do a short security runbook review and a signed NDAs/controls checklist.

Monica: can you attach the VPC/on-prem diagram and a short note on network isolation (what we can and cannot access) so Sarah can share with ACME IT?

I'll start reviewing the XLSX once it's in — Rachel, can you prepare procurement checklist items for this deal once security confirms?

Thanks,
Marcus

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Tan <sarah.tan@acme.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T08:45:00Z
Subject: VPC / On-prem Deployment diagram & network isolation notes

Hi Sarah —

Attaching a high-level diagram and a short summary of network isolation options. Key points: 

- Dedicated VPC: Deployed in customer VPC or peered VPC. No shared subnets or host-level access from Redwood. Traffic egress controlled by customer's route tables and security groups.
- VPC Peering + PrivateLink: We can support PrivateLink endpoints for control plane interactions; data plane stays within customer network.
- On-prem / Air-gapped: We provide a signed installation bundle (Docker/OCI images + install scripts) and an operations runbook. The deployment requires a one-time key exchange and an offline attestation step. No outbound connections required after initial registration if requested.

Attachment: redwood-vpc-deployment-diagram.png

Let me know if ACME IT wants a deeper network runbook — we can schedule a short technical session with our deployment engineers.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
